items.prompt: A European robin perched on a bare branch at night, its eye catching a faint light, the dark sky behind it crossed by the very faint arc of a compass-like field of lines, as though the bird sees something we cannot.

alt.ru: Малиновка на голой ветке ночью, в глазу отблеск; за ней в тёмном небе едва заметные дуги линий, будто птица видит то, чего не видим мы.
alt.en: A robin on a bare branch at night, a glint in its eye; behind it in the dark sky faint arcs of lines, as if the bird sees what we cannot.
alt.pt: Um pisco num ramo nu à noite, um reflexo no olho; atrás, no céu escuro, arcos ténues de linhas, como se a ave visse o que não vemos.
alt.es: Un petirrojo en una rama desnuda de noche, un destello en el ojo; detrás, en el cielo oscuro, tenues arcos de líneas, como si el ave viera lo que no vemos.

items.prompt: Extreme close-up of a green leaf held against the light in a dark greenhouse: the fine veins glowing, sunlight passing through cells, droplets of water on the surface. Quiet, microscopic, alive.

alt.ru: Крупный план листа на просвет в тёмной оранжерее: светятся тонкие прожилки, солнце проходит сквозь клетки, на поверхности капли воды.
alt.en: Close-up of a leaf against the light in a dark greenhouse: fine veins glowing, sunlight passing through the cells, water droplets on the surface.
alt.pt: Grande plano de uma folha contra a luz numa estufa escura: nervuras finas a brilhar, a luz a atravessar as células, gotas de água na superfície.
alt.es: Primer plano de una hoja a contraluz en un invernadero oscuro: finas nervaduras brillando, la luz atravesando las células, gotas de agua en la superficie.
